scripts.check-types: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.webview-behavior.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.webview.json
scripts.build: npm run check-types && npm run build:emit
scripts.test: npm run check:no-telemetry && npm run check:managed-fallback && npm run test:source-distribution && npm run build && npm run check:policy-docs && npm run test:webview-layout && npm run check:build-facts && npm run test:managed-modules && npm run test:managed-worktree && npm run test:unit
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check:lockfile && npm run check:release-metadata:identity && npm run build:emit

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Bachata starts AI command-line tools and repository commands against the files of this workspace, and those tools can be steered by the files they read. Until you trust this workspace, Bachata will not start an agent, and settings that grant write access, destructive actions, or a working directory outside the workspace are read from user settings only. Reading findings, decisions, and past runs still works.
